$comment: Token-economy settings for this repo. Two levers. (1) Deny reads of large derived files -- these are the real context bombs: package-lock.json is 208KB (~52k tokens) and graphify-out/graph.json is 120KB (~30k tokens), so one accidental read of either costs more context than a whole working session. Nothing here is worth reading by hand; all of it is generated. (2) No PreToolUse hooks: the previous graphify hook-guards spawned a subprocess and injected a MANDATORY instruction before every Bash, Grep, Read and Glob call, on a ~15-file Astro site whose .astro components tree-sitter cannot parse (1-3 nodes each; profile.ts, the source of truth for every fact on the site, yields 2). That is a per-call tax to consult a graph with nothing to say, and it had to be propagated into every subagent prompt as well. graphify remains installed, still rebuilds post-commit, and is invoked explicitly via /graphify when it genuinely helps -- see the graphify section of CLAUDE.md for where it pays.
